title: Microcosmos
description: A meeting of two artists, two cities and one shared microcosmos. Written in Thessaloniki and recorded in Berlin.
credits: Yiorgos Fanourakis & Nicolàs Sosa (Kafuné). Mixing & Mastering: Nicolàs Sosa (Kafuné). Footage: Melina Damatopoulou-Chalkiadaki. Written: August 22 2023. Recorded: August 27 2026.
